senses.gloss:
टट्टनी f. (-नी) A house lizard.
 E. टट्ट imitative sound, and न what makes,
from नी, affixes ड and ङीष्.

टट्टरी f. (-री)
 1. A joke, a jest.
 2. A kettle drum.
 3. Any musical ins-
trument.
 E. टट्ट imitative sound, and र what makes sound, and रा,
with ड and ङीष् affs.

टट्टुर m. (-रः) The sound of a drum.
 E. टट्टु imitative sound, tattoo,
and र what gets or has.
